description: Creates and fills groups of users, each member with a role; rows saved with neblla.db.save(data, { table, group }) belong to the group. "create" { name }; "delete" { name } removes it and its members: its rows stay, but no user reaches them; "add" { group, user, role } (again: changes the role); "remove" { group, user }. Roles are declared first with neblla_update_app_auth roles. Reads: neblla_group_read. More: neblla_get_llms tools/group

action.description: What to do. By action: create {name}; delete {name}; add {group, user, role}; remove {group, user}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

role.description: add: a role declared in the app's roles.

name: neblla_group
title: Manage user groups
